All tests pass. The implementation is in `bottle_song.go`:

- `Recite(startBottles, takeDown)` builds the lyrics verse by verse, separating verses with a blank line.
- `bottlesString(n)` spells out counts 0–10 ("no", "one", … "ten").
- `plural(n)` handles the singular/plural "bottle"/"bottles" distinction for both the opening lines and the "There'll be …" line.
- `strings.Title` capitalizes the spelled-out number at the start of each line (the test file's `Title` helper is for the test package only, so I avoided redeclaring it).

`go test ./...` reports `ok bottlesong` — all 7 test cases pass, and no other files were touched.
